name: PD 1134 was established by Ordinance No. 33202, passed by the Dallas City Council
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1134 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1134 was established by Ordinance No. 33202, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 27, 2025. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1134 is established on property on the east line of Marvin D Love Freeway and north of Camp Wisdom Road. The size of PD 1134 is approximately 2.82 acres. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered a residential zoning district. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article:

Exhibit 1134A: conceptual plan. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.105. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 1134A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.106. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For multifamily uses, a final plat may serve as the development plan.

(b) For all other uses, a development plan must be approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit to authorize work in the district. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.107. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-1(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.108. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.109. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: the yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-1(A) Multifamily District apply.

(b) Side and rear yard. No minimum side or rear yard are required.

(c) Density. For multifamily uses, the maximum number of dwelling units is 60.

(d) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 75 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(e) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 1,000 square feet.

(f) Stories. Maximum number of stories above is grade three. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For multifamily uses, two off-street parking spaces are required per unit.

(c) For guest parking, 0.25 off street parking spaces per unit are required. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33202)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1134.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33202)
